tasks.label: Initialize Nyumba Smart database
tasks.command: $h='C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\data\pg_hba.conf'; $b=$h+'.nyumba-backup'; $psql=(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -Recurse -Filter psql.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; Copy-Item $h $b -Force; try { $c=Get-Content $h -Raw; $c=[regex]::Replace($c,'(?m)^local\s+all\s+all\s+.*$','local   all             all                                     trust'); $c=[regex]::Replace($c,'(?m)^host\s+all\s+all\s+127\.0\.0\.1/32\s+.*$','host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            trust'); $c=[regex]::Replace($c,'(?m)^host\s+all\s+all\s+::1/128\s+.*$','host    all             all             ::1/128                 trust'); Set-Content $h $c -NoNewline; Restart-Service postgresql-x64-16; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "ALTER ROLE postgres PASSWORD 'jjdani';"; & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "CREATE ROLE nyumba_user LOGIN PASSWORD 'jjdani';" 2>$null; & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "ALTER ROLE nyumba_user PASSWORD 'jjdani';"; & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE nyumba_smart OWNER nyumba_user;" 2>$null; & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE nyumba_smart TO nyumba_user;" } finally { Copy-Item $b $h -Force; Remove-Item $b -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Restart-Service postgresql-x64-16; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 }

tasks.label: Restart PostgreSQL as administrator

tasks.label: Build Nyumba Smart database
tasks.command:
$s=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nyumba-db-init.ps1'; @'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$h = 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\data\pg_hba.conf'
$b = $h + '.nyumba-backup'
$psql = (Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -Recurse -Filter psql.exe | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
Copy-Item $h $b -Force
try {
  $c = Get-Content $h -Raw
  $c = [regex]::Replace($c, '(?m)^local\s+all\s+all\s+.*$', 'local   all             all                                     trust')
  $c = [regex]::Replace($c, '(?m)^host\s+all\s+all\s+127\.0\.0\.1/32\s+.*$', 'host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            trust')
  $c = [regex]::Replace($c, '(?m)^host\s+all\s+all\s+::1/128\s+.*$', 'host    all             all             ::1/128                 trust')
  Set-Content $h $c -NoNewline
  Restart-Service postgresql-x64-16
  Start-Sleep 3
  & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c 'ALTER ROLE postgres PASSWORD ''jjdani'';'
  & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c 'CREATE ROLE nyumba_user LOGIN PASSWORD ''jjdani'';' 2>$null
  & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c 'ALTER ROLE nyumba_user PASSWORD ''jjdani'';'
  & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE nyumba_smart OWNER nyumba_user;' 2>$null
  & $psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE nyumba_smart TO nyumba_user;'
} finally {
  Copy-Item $b $h -Force
  Remove-Item $b -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Restart-Service postgresql-x64-16
}
'@ | Set-Content $s
Start-Process powershell.exe -Verb RunAs -Wait -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$s
Remove-Item $s -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

tasks.label: Validate frontend local broadcast
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build

tasks.label: Restart backend after local messaging change
tasks.command: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($x in $c){ Stop-Process -Id $x.OwningProcess -Force }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; $env:DATABASE_URL='postgresql://nyumba_user:jjdani@localhost:5432/nyumba_smart'; node .\src\server.js

tasks.label: Verify local broadcast API
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3001/api/health -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('health='+$r.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Verify local broadcast record
tasks.command: $psql=(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -Recurse -Filter psql.exe | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; $env:PGPASSWORD='jjdani'; & $psql -P pager=off -U nyumba_user -h localhost -d nyumba_smart '-c' "SELECT landlord_code, tenant_phone, text, sender_role, sms_sent, sms_cost_ugx FROM messages WHERE text = 'Local app message test' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;"

tasks.label: Verify local broadcast record v2
tasks.command: $psql=(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -Recurse -Filter psql.exe | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; $env:PGPASSWORD='jjdani'; $q=@' SELECT landlord_code, tenant_phone, text, sender_role, sms_sent, sms_cost_ugx FROM messages WHERE text = 'Local app message test' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; '@; & $psql -P pager=off -U nyumba_user -h localhost -d nyumba_smart -c $q

tasks.label: Rebuild local messaging UI
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build

tasks.label: Trace all message producers
tasks.command: Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; Get-ChildItem .\src -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern 'smsService\.|INSERT INTO messages|sendOverdueReminder|sendPaymentConfirmation|sendLandlordPaymentAlert|sendBroadcast' -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line

tasks.label: Inspect tenant message API
tasks.command: Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; $l=Get-Content .\src\controllers\messagesController.js; $l[1..260]

tasks.label: Inspect payment notification calls
tasks.command: Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; $l=Get-Content .\src\controllers\paymentsController.js; $m=Select-String -Path .\src\controllers\paymentsController.js -Pattern 'smsService|sendPayment|sendLandlord|messages' ; foreach($x in $m){ $a=[Math]::Max(0,$x.LineNumber-12); $b=[Math]::Min($l.Length-1,$x.LineNumber+18); Write-Output ('--- lines '+($a+1)+'-'+($b+1)); $l[$a..$b] }

tasks.label: Read reminder function bounds
tasks.command: $l=Get-Content .\nyumba-backend\src\controllers\messagesController.js; $l[1..105]

tasks.label: Validate local messaging service
tasks.command: Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; node --check .\src\services\smsService.js; node --check .\src\controllers\messagesController.js; node --check .\src\controllers\paymentsController.js

tasks.label: Build local messaging frontend
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build

tasks.label: Restart local-only messaging backend
tasks.command: $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($x in $c){ Stop-Process -Id $x.OwningProcess -Force }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; $env:DATABASE_URL='postgresql://nyumba_user:jjdani@localhost:5432/nyumba_smart'; node .\src\server.js

tasks.label: Verify local messaging mode
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; node -e "const s=require('./src/services/smsService'); s.sendSms('+256700000000','local test').then(r=>console.log(JSON.stringify(r)))"; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3001/api/health -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('health='+$r.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Output ('health error='+$_.Exception.Message) }

tasks.label: Verify local mode health
tasks.command: Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:3001/api/health -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('health='+$r.StatusCode); Write-Output $r.Content } catch { Write-Output ('health error='+$_.Exception.Message) }

tasks.label: Locate SMS-only UI text
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem .\src -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern 'SMS reminder|SMS sent|SMS Reminders|SMS cost|SMS Message|SMS bill|SMS' -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line | Select-Object -First 100

tasks.label: Read local reminder UI handlers
tasks.command: $l=Get-Content .\src\App.tsx; $l[775..855]; $l[1770..1820]

tasks.label: Check final backend syntax
tasks.command: Set-Location .\nyumba-backend; node --check .\src\services\smsService.js; node --check .\src\controllers\messagesController.js

tasks.label: Build final local messaging UI
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build

tasks.label: Find SMS provider error
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem . -Recurse -File -Exclude node_modules | Select-String -Pattern 'SMS provider|provider is not configured|not configured|not defined' -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line

tasks.label: Check source messaging text
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem .\src,.\nyumba-backend\src -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern 'SMS provider|not configured|Dispatch SMS|Send rent reminder SMS|SMS Reminders' -CaseSensitive:$false | Select-Object Path,LineNumber,Line

tasks.label: Identify frontend processes
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' } | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000,3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess

tasks.label: Inspect remaining SMS UI text
tasks.command: $l=Get-Content .\src\App.tsx; foreach($n in @(789,794,805,812,821,827,836,841,847,854,858)){ Write-Output ($n.ToString()+': '+$l[$n-1]) }; Get-ChildItem .\nyumba-backend\src -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern 'SMS provider|not configured' -CaseSensitive:$false | ForEach-Object { $_.Path+':'+$_.LineNumber+': '+$_.Line }

tasks.label: Restart frontend cleanly
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Id 23320 -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; npm.cmd run dev
